description.value: District Bicycle Co. operates a satellite location at the top of Sun Peaks Resort village, serving mountain bikers and resort visitors with bike rentals, parts, accessories, and on-site repair support. The shop is embedded in the resort core and can source parts not on hand from their Kamloops flagship within 24 hours, making it a practical lifeline for cyclists who run into trouble mid-trip. It is part of a three-location company spanning Kamloops, Sun Peaks, and Valemount, with organized group rides as part of their community offering.
